author: Murphh
body:
Hello fellow avicus lovers,
I don't know if this has already been discussed, but it came up yesterday and I'd like to address it.

1) /start   (Can mods have the right to /start?)

Yesterday, we sat around for quite a long time (15 minutes) trying to get a game to start.  It seems like the mods were given the power to /start a few days ago, but for some reason, it was taken away.  Please give mods the power to /start.  It will make the community happy.

2) player count xml   (Can the player count xml be lowered for most maps?)

Also yesterday, we sat around for quite a bit waiting for enough players to join a match, so the game could start.  One map had 6v6 with 4 colors.  It was painful.  Players were logging in on their alts to help with the count.  The player count should be 2v2 at minimum.  Let players play the maps!  Please lower all player counts for all maps to 2v2.  Players eventually join and the match becomes better, but this at least gets the ball rolling.  Again, it will make the community so happy.

Thank you for considering! :)
Signed,
Avi-fan!
